source_lock.reference: Bert van Geemen, Some remarks on Brauer groups of K3 surfaces, arXiv:math/0408006v2
locations: Section 1.2: Br(X)=Sha(X), nonzero order n gives a genus-one fibration without section and minimal multisection degree n
Sections 8.1-8.3: Hermite binary-quartic Jacobian and symmetric 3x3 determinantal conic-bundle construction
Section 8.7: even Clifford Azumaya algebra; explicit note that Wittenberg's three-component branch case is a degenerate instance

fixed_kc_fibration.reason_distinct: r1-r2=4*t^2 is not the zero function; r1 and r2 are nonzero functions

hermite_binary_quartic_target.displayed_source_role: det(M) is the cubic branch of the Hermite Jacobian, up to the source's Weierstrass sign/coordinate normalization
hermite_binary_quartic_target.conic_bundle_role: M defines the conic bundle; its splitting double cover of the cubic branch encodes the order-2 Brauer class
hermite_binary_quartic_target.azumaya_role: after pullback to the Jacobian K3, the even Clifford bundle is the Brauer/Azumaya representative

degenerate_case_firewall.reason: Kc has full rational 2-torsion, so its Weierstrass cubic branch is reducible into three sections; moreover the rank-two Picard hypothesis of Theorem 7.6 is not the present singular-K3 situation.
degenerate_case_firewall.source_support_for_degenerate_route: Section 8.7 explicitly identifies Wittenberg's case where the cubic branch has three irreducible components as a degenerate case of the conic-bundle construction.

named_J2_inverse_problem.unknown: a Hermite-form symmetric matrix M_J2 (equivalently binary-quartic coefficients a0,...,a4 over the base) representing the named CV J2 class
required_conditions: det(M_J2) equals the Kc Weierstrass branch cubic after an explicitly certified admissible Weierstrass coordinate/scaling change
the even-Clifford/conic-bundle Brauer class of M_J2 is identified with the named CV J2 CSA, not merely with an unspecified nonzero Brauer class
the recovered binary-quartic surface X_J2 is a genus-one K3 with relative Jacobian Kc
